title: Maoh: Juvenile Remix
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High school student Ando can make other people say aloud what he is thinking. His city is caught between profit-driven redevelopment and Inukai, the charismatic leader of the vigilante group Grasshopper, and Ando comes to suspect a darker plan behind Inukai's appeal (Viz blurb via AniList; SLJ review). A 10-volume Shonen Sunday adaptation of Kotaro Isaka's story, with MangaUpdates tags for fascism, devoted followers, assassins and the death of family members.
life_message: It suggests that an ordinary person must think for himself and stand up to a persuasive mass movement rather than look away.
